Metadata.title: game.org.az — Sports Social Network of Azerbaijan
Metadata.description: One player card for multiple sports, venues with geo-search, public and private games. Sign in with Telegram.

Landing.badge: game.org.az — a sports social network for Azerbaijan
Landing.heroSubtitle: One player card for multiple sports, venues with geo-search, and games — public or just for your circle. No more messages lost in chats.

playerCard.title: Player card
playerCard.description: One profile for every sport you play: level, positions, game history — visible right away to whoever you invite.

venues.title: Venues nearby
venues.description: Fields, halls and courts with geo-search — find where to play without ten different chats.

events.title: Games and trainings
events.description: Public and private events with participant sign-up, guests, and a waitlist.

rating.title: Rating and reliability
rating.description: A Glicko-2 rating for every sport, plus a reliability score for not bailing on games last-minute.

login.title: Sign in with Telegram
login.description: No new passwords or sign-up forms — one tap in an app you already use.

profile.title: Fill in your profile
profile.description: Pick your sports, level and city — takes less than a minute.

findGame.title: Find a game
findGame.description: Browse nearby venues and events, join one or create your own.
